output.answer: [U1.2] The operator is required to notify any authority about an AI-caused network incident within a deadline that aligns with the requirements of the CSIRT reporting structure established by the entity.

global_examples.how_they_closed_it: National competent authorities shall immediately notify the Commission of any serious incident, whether or not they have taken action on it, in accordance with Article 20 of Regulation (EU) 2019/1020.

output.gap: The global examples do not provide specific deadlines for notification which are present in the UAE sources.
